description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Aether Channeler, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Aether Channeler, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
